newsitem.title: IRAN: Big blaze guts Iranian car plant warehouses.
newsitem.headline: Big blaze guts Iranian car plant warehouses.

text.p: A large fire has caused extensive damage to the warehouses of an Iranian car plant, newspapers said on Monday.

Fire officials said the Sunday morning blaze, at the state-run Saipa plant 13 km (8 miles) west of Tehran, was possibly the largest in the current Iranian year which began in March, the daily Ettelaat reported.
No official figures on the extent of damages were available, but a fire official estimated losses of "billions of rials", the newspaper said. (One billion rials = $333,000).
Some 80 firemen and 20 fire engines took an hour and a half to bring under control the blaze which gutted the 9,000-square metre (97,000-square feet) warehouse, it added.
($1=3,000 rials at the official exchange rate)
